pivotal_result: FOURIER, a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 27,564 patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease on statin therapy: the primary composite endpoint occurred in 1344 patients (9.8%) on evolocumab versus 1563 patients (11.3%) on placebo (hazard ratio 0.85; 95% CI 0.79 to 0.92; P less than 0.001), and the key secondary endpoint occurred in 816 patients (5.9%) versus 1013 patients (7.4%) (hazard ratio 0.80; 95% CI 0.73 to 0.88; P less than 0.001). Trial registration NCT01764633; paper DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa1615664, published online 2017-03-17.
